parameters.query:
SET search_path TO sales_prod, public, extensions;
WITH params AS (
  SELECT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF($1::text, '')::integer, 100), 1), 2000) AS scan_limit
), rows AS (
  SELECT
    c.id::text AS db_conversation_id,
    c.lead_id::text AS lead_id,
    c.chatwoot_conv_id,
    c.nombre,
    c.telefono,
    c.marca,
    c.modelo,
    c.quicklink_id::text AS quicklink_id,
    c.estado::text AS estado,
    c.active_interaction_id,
    c.active_interaction_type,
    c.expected_action,
    c.interaction_consumed,
    c.human_handoff,
    c.automation_enabled,
    c.updated_at::text AS updated_at,
    c.created_at::text AS created_at
  FROM conversaciones c
  WHERE c.chatwoot_conv_id IS NOT NULL
    AND UPPER(COALESCE(c.estado::text, '')) NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST', 'NOT_CONTACTABLE', 'DISCARDED', 'HANDOFF_HUMAN', 'CONTACTAR')
    AND COALESCE(c.human_handoff, false) = false
    AND COALESCE(c.automation_enabled, true) = true
  ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT (SELECT scan_limit FROM params)
)
SELECT
  now()::text AS checked_at,
  (SELECT scan_limit FROM params)::integer AS scan_limit,
  COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rows) ORDER BY updated_at DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows
FROM rows;
